issues.item: Negative Appraisals: Contamination: I feel dirty or contaminated because of what happened
issues.explanation: For stalking trauma, a contamination appraisal is hard to reconcile clinically with the rest of this profile. The other selected items center on interpersonal danger, hypervigilance, avoidance of places, and submissive safety behaviors. Feeling dirty/contaminated is more characteristic of sexual trauma or assault-related shame and does not fit the stalking-focused threat and strategy pattern here.

issues.item: Threat: Threat in Delays: When something takes longer than expected I assume something bad is happening

Delay-based threat suggests a different symptom focus and is weakly connected to the selected appraisals and strategies for this trauma profile.
